question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A medicine used to nullify the effect of poison
solution:
The correct answer is: **Antidote.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antidote** means a medicine taken or given to counteract a particular poison.

 
 
• ***Example *-** *Because he was bit by a snake, they had to give him the **antidote **so he would survive.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the **'Antidote'** can be used as a **one-word substitute for 'A medicine used to nullify the effect of poison.'**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Antibiotic** means medicine that inhibits the growth of or destroys microorganisms.
 
• **Antigen **means any substance that causes the body to make an immune response against that substance.
 
• **Antiseptic** means an antimicrobial substance or compound that is applied to living tissue/skin to reduce the possibility of infection, sepsis, or putrefaction.
